thread:
Leah M.: Flagging an inbound routing SLA gap from last night. ~8% of new HubSpot leads didn't get a Salesforce owner within 30s during the 09:10-09:25 UTC window. Logs show /assign 5xx retries and a couple of claim backlog spikes.
Javier R.: Is enrichment slow concurrently? That would explain the round-robin stalls.
Leah M.: Yes, enrichment averaged +1.1s TTL extensions. But the immediate pain is the claim flow stalls when enrichment delays. Example HS webhook payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "contact": {"email": "xxx@yyy.com", "lead_score": 82},
  "properties": {"utm_source": "ad", "country": "US"}
}
```
Priya S.: Proposal: short-circuit assignment for high-confidence leads (machine_score >= 75) so they get a fast owner; run enrichment asynchronously after assignment.
Javier R.: Sales concern: don't want false positives. Can we run on 5% traffic first and track mis-assignments?
Tom B.: Two implementation paths: (A) HubSpot workflow sets a `fast_assign` property when conditions match and our router bypasses enrichment; (B) increase assign worker concurrency + add jitter to round-robin to reduce contention. (A) is lower-risk and faster.
lead-processor-bot: observed 412 retries on /assign between 09:10-09:18 UTC, avg retry delay 350ms.
Leah M.: So plan: quick mitigation (A) as a canary + medium-term infra change (B). Priya, do we have a reliable realtime property?
Priya S.: Use `machine_score` (populated synchronously ~95% of time). Gate also on country in supported list to reduce FP.
Tom B.: I'll add a feature flag in the router and emit metrics: assign_latency and assign_fail_rate. Canary toggle available for 5% traffic. Can add PagerDuty alert if assign_fail_rate > 2%.
Leah M.: Draft rollout steps:
- TODAY: create HubSpot workflow to set `fast_assign` for machine_score>=75 AND country in {US,CA,EMEA} (owner: Priya)
- TODAY: Tom to implement router flag and metric hooks + enable 5% canary (owner: Tom)
- TOMORROW: 24h canary, monitor assign_latency, assign_fail_rate, and percent-assigned-within-30s (owners: Leah/Javier)
- CRITERIA: if assign_fail_rate <= baseline +1pp and latency improves -> roll to 100% and schedule concurrency/jitter infra tune (owners: Priya/Tom)
Javier R.: Also add a playbook entry: if enrichment backlog > threshold, move fast_assigned leads to a separate async enrichment queue so main assign path stays fast.
Leah M.: I'll write the playbook note and post link here. Tom, please add the Grafana panel and the PD alarm for the canary window.
Tom B.: Will do. I'll emit a 60m Slack pulse while canary runs summarizing percent-assigned-within-30s.
Priya S.: I'll start the HubSpot workflow draft and set it to draft 5% audience for the canary.
Leah M.: Thanks team. Goal: ship the HS workflow + router flag before tomorrow morning peak. I'll paste the playbook + rollback steps once ready. :thumbsup:
